leads.title: Crimes Act 1969
leads.documents: Prior criminal status of male homosexual activity in Cook Islands; penalties for sodomy, indecency between males, and keeping premises for homosexual acts
leads.detail: Cited as Crimes Act 1969, Sections 154 (Indecency between males - up to 5 years), 155 (Sodomy - up to 7 years, up to 14 years in certain cases), 159 (Keeping Place of resort for homosexual acts - up to 10 years), Sections 152 and 153 age of consent 16 for vaginal intercourse; lesbian sex not mentioned

leads.title: Crimes (Sexual Offences) Amendment Bill 2023
leads.documents: Decriminalization of homosexual acts between men effective 1 June 2023 by repealing Sections 154, 155 and 159
leads.detail: Passed 14 April 2023, came into effect June 1; passed with 19 MPs favouring and 4 against, as stated in article

leads.title: Crimes Bill 2017 - draft
leads.documents: Earlier decriminalization attempt, public submissions, reinstatement of ban and proposed extension to women, and delays to 2023
leads.detail: Announced August 2017, submissions began 9 August; put on hold for June 2018 general elections; ban reinstated 5 November 2019; debate deferred to 2021 due to COVID-19, then postponed to March 2023

leads.title: Marriage Amendment Act 2000 (clarified 2007)
leads.documents: Outlawing of same-sex marriage and legislative definition of gender of transsexuals; power of Registrar to void marriages
leads.detail: 2000 Act outlawed same-sex marriage; 2007 clarification: 'no person shall be permitted to marry another person who is of the same gender as him or herself'; Registrar of the High Court (Retita o te Akavaanga Teitei) power to void/dissolve

leads.title: Employment Relations Act 2012
leads.documents: Employment discrimination protection on basis of sexual orientation
leads.detail: Section 55(e) prohibits discrimination on basis of 'sexual preference' in employment; entered into force 1 July 2013

leads.title: Cook Islands Disability Act 2008
leads.documents: Prohibition of discrimination against disabled persons based on sexual orientation

leads.title: United Nations Development Programme - 2016 data
leads.documents: Population estimate and stigma indicators for men who have sex with men and transgender people in Cook Islands
leads.detail: 2016 UNDP estimate: 500-800 men who have sex with men and transgender people; 40% ashamed, 30% low self-esteem, 22% had both male and female partners in last 12 months

leads.title: University of the South Pacific survey via Cook Islands News
leads.documents: LGBTQ identification among Cook Islands college students
leads.detail: Reported late 2019: of 674 Cook Islands college students, 9.1% identified as LGBTQ, 22.7% 'refused or were unsure' - as reported by Cook Islands News

leads.title: Dr. Kalissa Alexeyeff, University of Melbourne
leads.documents: Cultural status of laelae / akava'ine and taboo around laelae sexuality after introduction of Western understandings; reports of beatings by male family members if caught
leads.detail: Academic fieldwork commentary cited in History section; notes laelae beaten up by male family members when caught engaging in homosexual relations

leads.title: cookislands.org.uk travel advice
leads.documents: Visitor-facing safety climate: general acceptance / laissez-faire to tourists but warning that public displays of affection may offend; community need for discretion
leads.detail: Travel website cookislands.org.uk cited in Living conditions section alongside travel advisories urging discretion and no public displays of affection
